What is the loss ratio on this policy?

The loss ratio on [ANT-HO-204585](/lightning/r/a00aj00003jKVNfAAO/view) is **2,008.9%**. Incurred losses are **$45,000** against an annual premium of **$2,240**.

All of it comes from one open claim, [00002118 – Burst pipe flooded finished basement](/lightning/r/500aj00003jKuVeAAK/view), which is Under Investigation:
- **Paid:** $5,000 (an advance for emergency drying)
- **Outstanding reserve:** $40,000

Most of the figure is reserve, so the ratio will change as the claim settles. The adjuster is still waiting on the mitigation invoice and the rebuild estimate. The underwriting notes already flag this loss as something to review at renewal on 15 Jan 2027.
